title: qmd extract --json
description: Extract bytes from a path, stdin (-) or HTTP(S) URL: no archive, queue, state or index. URL input uses the shared link fetcher. Unknown fields are null. Article metadata and fetch outcomes are optional v1 additions; producers emit them, older v1 payloads may omit them.

kind.description: Extracted document kind (text, ocr or transcript); null when unknown.

text.description: Complete extracted text, without rendered headers or model metadata.

pages.description: Page coverage from the shared extractor, or null for non-paged input.

title.description: Article title from web HTML, or null when unknown.

author.description: Article author from web HTML, or null when unknown.

published.description: Publication date as supplied by the extractor, or null when unknown.

fetched.description: Shared fetch outcome; null for local input. Attempts include tunnel startup time and survive queued retries.

status.description: Last HTTP status; null before a response.

error.description: Short pipeline error code; null on success. Exit 0 on success, 4 on failure.
